notes.title: Online Multiplayer Re-Workening
notes.notes:
Good news! We found that the online multiplayer facilitator was ... not ... doing that for a while. It's been kicked, and now should be working at full speed getting people together regardless of whatever weird network topologies and setups you have at your house.

If you're having problems connecting to friends with this update, be sure to let us know at @no_goblin on Twitter! If you're having trouble matchmaking and finding random people online, well, let's be honest: this is a four year game that didn't establish a multiplayer community on Steam. You might be waiting a little while. We still love you though, and we hold out hope that you'll find The One while waiting on the information superhighway.

-NG

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - 100ft Robot Golf, 25% off!
notes.notes:
100ft Robot Golf is Now Available on Steam and is 25% off!*

100ft Robot Golf is a fast-paced arcade golf game where you get to control impossibly large robots on their quest for par. Just swing your golf club to smash even the tallest buildings out of the way - or into the way of your robot golfing buddies.

*Offer ends March 23 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: 100ft Robot Golf stomps onto PC next week
notes.notes: Lay out your 50ft tartan trousers, your 40ft argyle jumper, and your 10ft leather glove, as 100ft Robot Golf [official site] is coming to PC next Thursday, March 16th. It’s the next game from No Goblin, the makers of silly spin ’em up Roundabout, and it is exactly what its name suggests. Huge robots will be playing golf across human cities, in oceans, on the moon, and all over the place, stomping and smashing buildings and screwing with each other. Following a PlayStation 4 debut last year, 100ft Robot Golf is coming to PC improved and fancied-up. … [visit site to read more]
